summary: This bill establishes the People-Centered Assistance Reform Effort Commission to review all federal means-tested welfare programs, identify ways to streamline and improve their effectiveness, and propose legislation to consolidate and realign these programs to increase social mobility and reduce poverty.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a commission to review and recommend reforms for a wide array of means-tested welfare programs, with the stated purpose of increasing social mobility and reducing reliance on federal assistance. The commission is tasked with identifying ways to streamline programs, consolidate them, reduce costs, and encourage individuals to transition off welfare, which aligns with reducing welfare spending.

The bill establishes a commission tasked with reviewing all means-tested welfare programs to identify consolidations, efficiencies, cost reductions, program repurposing, and transitions to discretionary funding, while requiring an explicit estimate of outlay savings from the resulting legislation. This makes deficit reduction through welfare reform a central purpose of the bill.
